lane: DISCOVERY (development folds only) -- may not replace Arm D
hypothesis: turnover rate changes most when a player occupies a substantially DIFFERENT offensive role than normal, not simply because the role is large
sign_convention: INCUMBENT(D) absolute error MINUS CHALLENGER absolute error; POSITIVE = challenger beats D

recalibration_control.why: every ridge arm here has an unpenalised intercept that frozen Arm D lacks, so free recalibration alone is worth about the size of the effect being hunted
recalibration_control.standard: vs-K0 is the honest test of whether the FEATURES add anything

verdict_block.rule: primary arm must beat the K0 recalibration control on operational team MAE with a 90% game-clustered CI excluding zero

estimator.offset: log(exposure) + log(D_ewma_shrunk); beta=0 reproduces Arm D
estimator.validation: walk-forward by season; training-fold standardisation only

K0_intercept_only.role: CONTROL: intercept-only recalibration of the frozen Arm D offset. Any arm that does not beat K0 has added nothing beyond a free level shift.

L1_linear.role: PRIMARY linear arm: role level (projected share) + role change + rank change + bounded material-expansion ramp

N1_split.role: PRIMARY bounded nonlinear arm: the ONE preregistered nonlinear form -- role_change replaced by its positive/negative hinge split

D0_level_only.role: role LEVEL alone -- 'the role is large'

D0_change_only.role: role CHANGE alone -- 'the role is DIFFERENT than normal'

S1_trailing_basis.role: same 4-D span as L1 with the NORMAL role as the level coordinate; a coefficient conclusion that flips between L1 and S1 is a parameterisation artefact

X_literal_card_set.role: the literal five-feature card set; EXACTLY rank deficient (role_change == proj - trailing). Ridge returns a finite fit anyway. Reported as evidence that the pairwise gate does not catch a three-term dependency. NOT a scientific result.

p2_trailing_columns_DISCARDED.defect: built by iterating the realised box score and left-merging onto the candidate universe, so the null mask is an EXACT did_appear indicator -- post-cutoff outcome information
p2_trailing_columns_DISCARDED.action: dropped outright and rebuilt; never imputed

trailing_role_rebuild.machine: EWMA alpha=0.1, new = (1-alpha)*old + value, state snapshotted BEFORE the day's games are consumed (strictly prior games)
trailing_role_rebuild.change_vs_p2: state is READ for every universe member on its own game date, appearer or not; the box score only UPDATES state
trailing_role_rebuild.universe: Tier A candidate rows UNION intrinsic realised-participant rows

share_identity_check.claim: proj_minutes_share and proj_off_poss_share are algebraically identical
share_identity_check.consequence: proj_off_poss_share is NEVER read by this workstream

derived_columns.rotation_rank_change: trailing_rotation_rank - proj_rotation_rank; POSITIVE = the player is projected further UP the rotation than normal
derived_columns.expanded_role_bounded: clip((role_change - 0.05) / (0.1 - 0.05), 0, 1); bounded ramp, zero unless the role expands materially

feature_provenance.no_new_leakage_surface: all derived columns are pointwise functions of P2 columns whose chronological isolation was already validated

intrinsic.note: realised participants absent from the Tier A candidate universe; their standardised features are set to the training mean (0), so they receive the Arm D prediction times exp(intercept)

leakage_guard.note: zero nulls on the operational track means no missingness indicator exists and fillna(0) is a no-op there; a non-zero corr_with_did_appear is legitimate signal only because these values are computable strictly before the cutoff

L1_linear.note: exact rank deficiency means ridge chooses a point in a flat direction; the coefficients are then a property of the penalty, not of the data

intrinsic.reading: observed_over_expected > 1 means the frozen Arm D rate UNDER-predicts turnovers in that bin

operational.reading: observed_over_expected > 1 means the frozen Arm D rate UNDER-predicts turnovers in that bin

exposure_error_attribution.reading: a strong monotone gradient here means the role-change features are an EXPOSURE-projection correction, not a turnover-RATE effect
